scope: Inference policy for the specified physical rotor and responsive halo. Pilot admission, complete stage funding and source/storage review are separate.

complete55_target.primary: signed responsive twin C_live at T200
complete55_target.secondary: signed trapezoid C_live over T180-200 at the same recorded two-unit nodes

estimands.primary: C_live(T=200) = (Omega_plus-Omega_minus)/Omega_initial; ensemble mean of the SIGNED paired library contrast
estimands.secondary: Trapezoid of C_live on the recorded two-unit nodes T180–200, divided by20; secondary only
estimands.display: D_Omega = abs(mean signed C_live); fold intervals through zero, never average absolute draw contrasts
estimands.fixed_comparator: C_fixed and responsive-minus-fixed are descriptive; this numerical campaign does not qualify their refinements
estimands.sampling_unit: A complete independent randomized initial library; all populations, fields, times and numerical arms remain paired

sampling.reference: Nominal pointwise Student-t7 interval for the eight-library mean. It is not generally calibrated simultaneous or frequentist coverage.

refinement_proxy.matched_shift: For each arm, refined C_live minus the SAME first-four baseline C_live, before averaging. Do not subtract the eight-library baseline mean.
refinement_proxy.coordinate: Apply independently to declared endpoint and recorded late-window estimands.
refinement_proxy.arm_allowance: U_arm = max(abs(lower),abs(upper)) of the nominal pointwise t3 interval for the four paired refined-minus-baseline shifts.
refinement_proxy.aggregate: E_refinement = sum of the five nonnegative U_arm values. Do not cancel numerical arms or infer independence.
refinement_proxy.coverage: Descriptive refinement proxy, not a rigorous true-error bound or calibrated joint coverage. No five-percent guarantee is claimed.
refinement_proxy.missing_or_partial_arm: UNQUALIFIED; do not assign zero allowance or infer convergence
refinement_proxy.fixed_refined_and_refined_F0: Not covered; retained historical scopes cannot be promoted to general convergence.

conservation.scope: Actual recorded postrelease nodes T20–200; account growth work and clamp/axis torque separately; no total binding-energy denominator.
conservation.energy: For each baseline twin and each available refined twin, max_abs(autonomous_energy_residual) / max_abs(actual_rotor_K_exchange) must be <=0.01.
conservation.angular: For each baseline twin and each available refined twin, max_norm(autonomous_vector_L_minus_support_residual) / max_abs(postrelease_bar_impulse) must be <=0.01.
conservation.zero_exchange: Ratio undefined; this budget qualification is not established. Preserve absolute residual and denominator, never insert a favorable floor.
conservation.primary_proxy: B_L = largest over the required responsive baseline/refined libraries of [max_abs(corrected postrelease total-L z residual_plus)+max_abs(corrected postrelease total-L z residual_minus)]/(I_bar*Omega_initial). Use each recorded z component, not the vector-norm maximum or algebraic bar-rotor residual.
conservation.total_proxy: E_num = E_refinement + B_L. This sum is operational and conservative, not a proof that all errors are bounded.
conservation.required_membership: Responsive baseline plus/minus, all eight independent libraries; responsive refined plus/minus, all first-four libraries in all five arms. Fixed-field and F0 conservation readouts remain reported descriptively and are not silently included in or dropped from this C_live qualification. Unforced paths have no bar-release/exchange qualification.
conservation.support: T20–200 after each actual release. Baseline and growth-reader histories have101nodes with pre-release missing values; retain nodes10–100 inclusive. f39 four-arm V/J/E/K/R arrays already contain91postrelease nodes; retain all91, not another slice10–100.

decisions.numerical_share_test: E_num <= min(0.02,0.20*abs(mean C_live)) for a magnitude-qualified nonzero comparison.
decisions.rationale: The absolute ceiling allocates at most two percentage points of the initial pattern speed, one fifth of the predeclared ambitious ten-percent target. The relative condition stops that ceiling from qualifying errors comparable to a smaller measured contrast.
decisions.expanded_interval: [baseline nominal t7 lower - E_num, baseline nominal t7 upper + E_num]. This is explicitly a proxy-expanded interval.
decisions.sign_supported: All required genuine runs/readers and budget checks complete, magnitude test passes, and the expanded primary interval excludes zero.
decisions.ten_percent_prioritization: Require sign_supported, including the magnitude-share and complete-control/budget conditions, THEN require lower endpoint>=0.10 in the zero-aware absolute image of the expanded primary interval. This is a prioritization target, not a definition of discovery.
decisions.unresolved: If the expanded interval includes zero, any required control/budget is incomplete or fails, OR the magnitude-share test fails, preserve the estimate and mark the ordering/qualification unresolved or unqualified as applicable. An interval excluding zero alone does not override these requirements. Do not report a physical null.
decisions.negative_or_bound: An informative upper bound requires the same complete controls and explicit proxy limitation. Absence of significance alone is not a bound.

preparation.passive_impulse: Diagnostic only, neither subtractable driven bias nor a rigorous forecast/error bound.
preparation.continuum_vs_particles: Exact initial density/local-current/even-DF identities belong to the continuum family; finite packet realization and self-gravitating evolution require measurements.
preparation.instability: If coherent growth survives number/basis/time/angle controls, investigate collective instability rather than labeling a quiet-halo pass.

boundaries: Not a live stellar disk or a complete galaxy.
No total-halo or observationally measured pattern-speed distribution is predicted here.
No SIDM/CDM comparison or dark-matter microphysics.
No prescribed-field cos(beta) identity applied to autonomous population-dependent fields.
No exact formation route from the specified smooth F0; quadratic phase-space restriction remains.
No novelty claim merely that a DF or global spin affects bar response.
No general convergence, asymptotic evolution, calibrated confidence coverage or exact continuum error guarantee.

funding.rule: The original exact50 stage and separate five-job growth companion are funded from one aggregate240h account. Named confirmation jobs consume the same35h allocation, never an extra35h.
funding.cost_pilot: One preselected seed7510101 responsive and fixed fullT200 driver, with allF0/twin populations and usual recordings, can measure whole cost before any main admission. It grants no physical qualification and no automatic matrix expansion.

supersedes_before_any_forcing.reason: Independent source review requested explicit decision inheritance and conservation membership; no physical/numerical outcome was used.

implementation_requirement: Neither original reader automatically applies this combined five-arm policy. A separately authenticated assessment must combine its exact outputs under this pinned policy; reader completion alone is not a policy PASS.
